Name: Sea Breeze Farmhouse
Author: collingbe
Description:
[size=3]update 1.0.6:
[list]
[*][size=3]updated for 1.6. [/size]
[*][size=3]does not depend on custom spouse room anymore.[/size]
[*][size=3][b][color=#ffff00]NOTE：[/color][/b]couldn't find solve for floating tile issue for the second upgrade, a temporary work around is turned on by default, and can be toggled using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3]﻿[/size]. If you have any mod that changes the farmhouse color or kitchen, the floating tile might still show, it can be fixed by renaming this mod's folder to something like "z_Sea Breeze Farmhouse".[/size]
[*]1.6 更新
[*]不再需要custom spouse room前置
[*][b][color=#ffff00]注意：[/color][/b]暂时无法根除二次升级后，二楼的浮空方块。掩耳盗铃（不）的解决方法默认开启，可以用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3]﻿更改。厨房美化和农舍内部美化可能会有冲突，可以通过重命名此mod文件夹（例如"z_Sea Breeze Farmhouse"）解决。[/size]
[*]1.6 업데이트
[*]더 이상 맞춤 custom spouse room 에 의존하지 않습니다.
[*][b][color=#ffff00]참고:[/color][/b] 두 번째 업그레이드를 위한 부유 타일 문제의 해결책을 찾을 수 없었습니다. 임시 해결 방법이 기본적으로 활성화되어 있으며, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]를 사용하여 토글할 수 있습니다. 농장집 색상이나 부엌을 변경하는 모드가 있을 경우, 부유 타일이 여전히 보일 수 있습니다. 이 모드의 폴더 이름을 "z_Sea Breeze Farmhouse"와 같이 변경하면 수정될 수 있습니다.









[/list]





update 1.0.5:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]didn't find solve for multiplayer warp issue, please check the [/size][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]multiplayer[/b][/size][/color][size=3] box in [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ if you are not the host. Also be sure to [b][color=#ffff00][size=3]delete[/size][/color][/b] the "spouse room relocate" folder if you are not the host for correct location of spouse room.
[*][size=3]无法解决联机小屋传送问题，联机玩家需要用[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3]﻿勾选[/size][b][color=#ffff00][size=4]multiplayer[/size][/color][/b][size=3]选项。联机玩家记得[b][color=#ffff00]删除[/color][/b]"spouse room relocate"文件夹，否则配偶房间位置会不对。[/size]
[*][size=3]added standalone [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587?tab=description]downtown zuzu[/url]﻿ apartment addon, can be found on the right side of room 1d. note that the kitchen is not functional, and the wallpaper and floor cannot be changed. if you are using modded kitchen or farmhouse interior, replace the png files in the folder "Zuzu" with the png from the mod you are using. [/size]
[*][size=3]增加独立 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587?tab=description]downtown zuzu[/url] 公寓拓展，在1d号公寓右边。注意厨房是不能用的，壁纸和地板也不能更换。如果想把厨房和楼梯等换成其他美化，把“zuzu”文件夹内的png替换为你想换的美化即可。[/size]
[/list]


[size=3]update 1.0.4:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]includes option to replace the ginger island farmhouse with the second upgrade layout, default is set to false.(use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to toggle setting)   [/size]增加用第二次升级替换姜岛农舍内部的选项，默认选项为关闭。（用 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ 更改选项）
[*]fixes that crib cannot be removed   修正婴儿床不能被移除
[*][s]fixes multiplayer cabin wrong warp location   修正联机小屋传送点[/s]
[/list]


[size=3]The second upgrade includes a small beachside farm and a rooftop pool area.[/size]
[size=3]all couch/bed can be interacted with, i.e. you can sit on them.[/size]
[size=3]The spouse room is on the right side of the master bedroom(or how i use that room)[/size]
[size=4][b][color=#ffff00]If your spouse is a modded npc[/color][/b], please modify the "content.json" file in the "Sea Breeze spouse room relocate" folder so their spouse room will show up in the correct location. SVE, Ridgeside npcs are already compatible.[/size]



[size=3]Mods used in screenshot:[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7573]Arhen's Beige Wood Tone Interior Set[/url]﻿
[*]walls and floors by [url=https://stardew-arhen.tistory.com/7]Arhen[/url] (Highly recommend)﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5857]Rustic Country Walls and Floors[/url]﻿ by dustbeauty
[*]﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444]Industrial Furniture Set[/url] by dustbeauty
[*]﻿Yellog's furniture set (no longer on nexus)
[*]furniture by [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/334101]sulllll[/url] (needs naver account)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10932]IdaIda's Furniture Recolor (for AT)[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13893]Casual Furniture Set[/url] by katestardew﻿
[/list]



[color=#ffff00]Known problems[/color][size=3] ﻿[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b][color=#ff0000]Important!!: [/color]remove the furnitures before upgrading, or else you might not be able to reach them[/b][/size]
[*][size=4]if you are using sve please start a new save after installing this mod[/size][size=2] [/size][size=3]or there might be a persistent floating tile on the second floor, and i have no idea what causes this.[/size]
[*][size=2]after the first upgrade，if you spawn in the void. walk to the lily pad and you will be warped to the entrance.[/size]
[*]the wall behind the crib is missing (fix: apply wallpaper to the nursary again).
[*]when entering from the cellar, player is warped to inside a wall instead of on the cellar entry stairs. (fix: moving around slightly will warp the player back to the cellar entry stairs.)
[*]if you dont have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿﻿ installed, when warping from the garden/roof to the farmhouse, you will be warped to the entrance of the farmhouse. [color=#ffff00][b]Note[/b][/color] that this is not a hard dependency, so you can choose to not install it. 
[*]the fridge is accessabe in the bathroom of the first upgrade, this wont affect gameplay.
[*]known to be incompatible with some event mods which takes place inside the farmhouse
[*]if you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5351?tab=files]Industrial Kitchen and Interior[/url], make sure to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ and select the "Kitchen fix manual switch" option.﻿
[/list]

[size=3]第二次升级后新增海边小花园和屋顶泳池。
所有的沙发、床都是可互动的，可以坐上去。
配偶房间在主卧右侧（至少我拿那个房间当主卧hhh）
如果你的配偶是mod加的，一定要改 "Sea Breeze spouse room relocate"内的"content.json" 文件，不然配偶房间会出现在奇怪的地方。SVE, 里奇赛德的npc都已经兼容了。
[/size]



[color=#ffff00][size=3]已知问题
[/size][/color][list]
[*][size=4][b][color=#ff0000]非常重要！！：[/color]升级前一定要把家具先捡起来，不然升级后可能就碰不到了[/b][/size]
[*][b]如果你用SVE一定要开新档 [/b][size=3]不然二楼会有一块去不掉的东西，而且我也不知道这是怎么回事。[/size]
[*][size=3]第一次升级后如果被传送到房间左边，碰到荷叶就能传送回农舍入口了。[/size]
[*][size=3]婴儿床后面的墙壁缺失（解决方法：装完壁纸后再装一遍地板）。[/size]
[*][size=3]从地窖进入农舍时会被传送到二楼墙内（解决方法：稍微移动一下就会被传送回地窖楼梯口）。[/size]
[*][size=3]如果没有安装 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿﻿ ，在从花园/顶楼进入农舍时会被传送到大门口。[color=#ffff00]注意[/color]此前置可装可不装，装了会更方便一点。[/size]
[*][size=3]第一次升级后的浴室里可以打开冰箱，此bug不会影响正常游戏。[/size]
[*][size=3]与部分农舍内部的剧情mod不兼容[/size]
[*][size=3]如果同时使用 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5351?tab=files]Industrial Kitchen and Interior[/url] 需要用 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]勾选 "Kitchen fix manual switch"选项。[/size]
[/list]

[size=3]Credits:[/size]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url] for inspiration, coding of warps, and her beautiful foliage [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url].
waterfall by Maleha.
